name: MeowAtlas fixed listening atlas
purpose: Explore and audition the existing 440 recordings; no context or emotion prediction

features.normalization: one population z-score across the entire unpadded spectrogram of each clip
features.padding: right-pad standardized spectrogram with zeros to 854 frames; zero means standardized mean, not acoustic silence

cat_filter: subset of the fixed global coordinates; do not refit when filtering

selection.basis: Literature-informed features, conventional UMAP settings and prior label-free neighborhood/stability evaluation; not asserted to be universally optimal

limits: Clip duration, onset timing and background sound affect feature distances
Euclidean vector norms depend on the unpadded spectrogram duration
2D proximity and empty spaces do not establish perceptual similarity or distinct classes
Recording context is metadata, not an emotion or intention label
